name: Scaled matched-budget CSP primary complete
purpose: Complete the scaled primary matched-budget A_cache vs C_incontext mechanism-isolation curve for sudoku and futoshiki using symbolic-CBJ targeting, n=64 per task, fixed per-task B* anchors, Wilson CIs, and conservative A-C gap CIs. This supersedes item120's partial checkpoint progress for CSP tasks. Graph_color variants and external baselines remain pending, so this does not yet promote the full three-task/SOTA claim.

provenance.spec: user SPEC Matched-Budget Head-to-Head Addenda: scaled primary n>=64 per task, Wilson CI, fixed B* grid

code_added_used.change: Fixes merge de-duplication, prevents checkpoint/final shard double-counting, and stops C-side growing-context re-tokenization after all C budgets are exhausted.
Merges only final shard JSON files rather than checkpoint JSON files.

commands.purpose: Resume and complete the n=64 sudoku/futoshiki symbolic-CBJ scaled primary shards.
Re-merge final shard files only after fixing the double-counting glob.

headline.sudoku: n=64. At B*=28070, A solve=0.890625, C solve=0.109375, gap=0.78125; conservative gap CI [0.5820,0.8920] excludes 0.
headline.futoshiki: n=64. At B*=3206226, A solve=1.0, C solve=0.296875, gap=0.703125; conservative gap CI [0.5257,0.8009] excludes 0.
headline.shape: A dominates C on all five grid budgets for both CSP tasks; every grid point has gap>=0.484 and conservative gap CI above 0.
headline.single_next_move: Run graph_color symbolic-CBJ and C1 reasoning matched-budget variants, then evaluate full three-task promotion rule; keep external baselines as repo-provenance/not-run until ports are implemented.

gate_outcomes.number: A dominates C at 5/5 grid budgets for both sudoku and futoshiki.
CSP tasks satisfy numeric promotion condition, but graph_color variants and external baselines are not complete.

decision.next_step_routing: Treat solve@budget conversion as strongly supported on CSP mechanism-isolation. Do not claim full spec promotion until graph_color symbolic/C1 matched-budget curves are added and external baselines are either run or explicitly final-not-run.

honesty.does_not_establish: This item does not establish the full three-task promotion rule or SOTA competitiveness because graph_color symbolic/C1 variants and external baseline curves are still pending.
honesty.merge_fix: An initial broad glob double-counted final and checkpoint shard JSON files; the merge was fixed to deduplicate by task/source/policy/method/budget and final artifact was regenerated with n=64 per task.
honesty.external_limit: External repos have only been located/read for provenance; no LFS, First Finish, Beyond-the-Frontier, ToT/RAP, or best-of-n curve is reported here.
honesty.positive_read: For the completed CSP mechanism-isolation tasks, exact cache-truncation converts the cost advantage into a large solve@budget advantage under the same symbolic-CBJ policy and shared token counter.
